title: gts-touchpoint-prep-northwood-retail-ryan
body:
Meeting: GTS touchpoint — Northwood Retail (renewal in Q2)
Owner: Ryan Park (CS)
Date: 2026-03-12 10:00 PT (30m)
Attendees: Sarah Liu (Head of Data), Tomas Rivera (Platform Eng), me, optional: Marco (SE)
Context snapshot:
- Northwood running Redwood-hosted API for product recommendations (v1) in production across 3 regions. Monthly spend ~ $28k.
- Pilot for deduped embeddings + reranking shipped Jan; saw 6% CTR lift but latency spike during peak weekends.
- Renewal window opens 2026-04-01. They sign annual contract but are budget-sensitive; procurement will push for lower unit cost.
- Open risks: latency regressions on weekend traffic, lack of clear SLO SLA mapping in contract, and a stalled Dedicated capacity conversation (SE proposal sent 2026-02-05, waiting).
Meeting goals (my top 3):
1) Surface current production health and confirm latency SLO tolerances for their business (what they consider acceptable).
2) Re-establish timeline/commitment for Dedicated capacity evaluation — nudge Tomas to prioritize infra checklist with Marco.
3) Lock down renewal cadence: confirm decision makers and likely procurement constraints; propose an exec review slot if needed.
Agenda (30m):
- 0-3m: quick check-in + goals for this call
- 3-10m: recent performance summary (I present telemetry highlights, weekend spike graph)
- 10-18m: technical blockers & Dedicated proposal status (SE speaks to proposed infra changes)
- 18-25m: commercial runway & procurement questions (I surface options: pricing band, burst credits, short-term credits)
- 25-30m: next steps + owners
Key datapoints to have ready (bring these as single-slide screenshots):
- 7d P95 latency by region (prod) and a weekend vs weekday comparison
- Token spend trend last 90 days and projection if traffic grows 20%
- Incidents: list of incidents (with root cause if known) in last 60 days and mitigations applied
Probing questions I want to ask:
- "What latency threshold would force you to route away from Redwood?" (try to get a number in ms)
- "If we commit a dedicated pool, what timeline and capacity would you need for a pilot?"
- "Who will sign off on commercial terms — procurement only or does the Head of Data need to weigh in?"
- "Are there feature requests (observability/metrics) that would materially change your renewal decision?"
Negotiation levers I can test during call:
- 6-month reserved pricing bridge with a follow-on evaluation; include limited burst credits for peaks.
- Include an SLA addendum for P95 latency for key routes (trial 3 months).
- Offer a short-term Optimize review (free) that will recommend batching/quantization to reduce unit cost by X%.
Technical checklist for SE (Marco) before next sync (quick items):
- Confirm Dedicated instance sizing options and expected latency improvement numbers for their model family
- Validate KV cache hit rates and propose cache key TTL changes
- Review model variants (quantized vs fp16) impact on quality metrics — have delta numbers ready
Notes-to-self (shorthand):
- Keep the tone consultative; show telemetry but avoid full deep-dive unless they ask.
- If procurement pushes price only, pivot to risk and uptime guarantees + pilot Dedicated as outcome-based concession.
- If Tomas stalls again, escalate to Solutions lead for a firm handoff (cc: Priya).
Potential red flags during call (instant actions):
- If they say "we saw no measurable lift": ask for evaluation set and commit to a follow-up eval within 7 days (action: Marco).
- If they mention competitive bid: request procurement timeline and competitor pricing (we need to model counteroffer).
- If no clear decision owner: propose an executive review slot and set a date now (do not leave open-ended).
Quick links to reference during the call:
- Account plan (Confluence) — link in header
- SE proposal doc (PR link above)
- Weekend spike trace: /internal/traces/Northwood/2026-03-07

Marco Diaz | Run Dedicated sizing bench and provide expected P95 improvements (due 2026-03-18)
Elliot Kim | Model quality delta for quantized variant (PSNR/accuracy) on NWD eval set (due 2026-03-15)
Priya Shah | Draft renewal outreach + exec review invite template (due 2026-03-13)
Tomas Rivera | Confirm procurement stakeholders and internal timeline (we'll capture during call)
